summary: Sergio Perez won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix Sprint from P2 on the grid, 4.5s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with Max Verstappen completing the podium.
Pierre Gasly made the biggest climb, from P17 to P13.
Lando Norris had a day to forget, dropping from P10 to P17.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 13 points over Sergio Perez.
